name: ChrisPirillo/snubbles
description: Snubbles is a high-precision generative formula visualizer that creates stunning abstract art using mathematical precision. Experiment with complexity, tuning, and density to generate unique digital masterpieces.

name: ChrisPirillo/santas-blitz
description: Santa's Blitz is an addictive, holiday-themed match-3 arcade game. Match ornaments, trees, and wreaths to score points and climb the leaderboard in this festive winter challenge.

name: ChrisPirillo/node-moe
description: Node Moe is a high-performance interactive network visualizer and dynamic particle engine. Customize geometry, physics, and post-processing optics in real-time to create stunning generative art.

name: ChrisPirillo/midi-mixer
description: MIDI Mixer is a high-performance, generative MIDI studio and synth engine. Create, randomize, and export professional MIDI sequences and WAV audio directly in your browser with vintage CRT aesthetics.

name: ChrisPirillo/liquid-evolution
description: Liquid Evolution, a high-performance interactive 3D generative sphere. Customize colors, noise distortion, and geometry evolution speed in real-time. Designed by Chris Pirillo.

name: ChrisPirillo/joy-field
description: Experience Joy Field, a sophisticated generative art engine. Interact with 3D procedural geometries including Mobius strips, DNA helices, and vortex fields using Three.js and GLSL shaders. Features real-time physics, audio reactivity, and 4K export capabilities.

name: ChrisPirillo/jaws
description: Test your nerves in Jaws, a high-stakes retro arcade game. Carefully remove swallowed junk from the shark's mouth before the timer runs out and the jaws snap shut! A precision-based browser experience.

name: ChrisPirillo/gesture-blaster
description: Experience Gesture Blaster, a high-intensity gesture-controlled arcade game. Use hand tracking technology to aim and zap targets in real-time. Created by Chris Pirillo.

name: ChrisPirillo/fish-frenzy
description: Play Fish Frenzy, an intense underwater arcade survival game. Eat smaller fish to grow, dodge deadly sharks, and rule the ocean. Created by Chris Pirillo.

name: ChrisPirillo/block-blast
description: Play Block Blast, the ultimate precision-based block puzzle royale. Strategy meets arcade action in this addictive puzzle game. Drag blocks to clear lines, boost your score, and master the grid.

name: ChrisPirillo/beneath-air
description: Experience Beneath Air, a high-performance interactive fractal visualizer. Explore infinite Mandelbox variations, customize mathematical parameters in real-time, and export stunning 4K wallpapers. A masterclass in WebGL performance and vibe coding.

name: ChrisPirillo/voice-velocity
description: Voice Velocity is a high-octane synthwave runner game controlled by your voice. Scream to jump and whisper to run in this neon arcade experience.

name: ChrisPirillo/tinsel-trees
description: Design your own retro-futuristic Tinsel Tree in 3D. A generative art arcade experience featuring physics-based tinsel, customizable lighting, and procedural ornaments.

name: ChrisPirillo/the-blob
description: Experience 'The Blob', a real-time interactive 3D WebGL blobby fire simulation. Customize flame geometry, lighting, and colors in this immersive digital arcade experiment.

name: ChrisPirillo/text-replacer
description: A secure, client-side browser tool for finding and replacing text across multiple files instantly. Features drag-and-drop folder scanning, Regex support, case sensitivity, and bulk file editing without server uploads.

name: ChrisPirillo/system-six
description: A fully functional web-based simulation of the classic System 6 operating system. Features pixel-perfect apps, games like Snake and Pong, and a nostalgic 1-bit grayscale interface.

name: ChrisPirillo/rabbits-multiply
description: Play Rabbits Multiply, a fun educational math game where you help a bunny jump through levels by solving multiplication problems. Master math facts in this arcade adventure.

name: ChrisPirillo/petalworks
description: Petalworks is an immersive, real-time interactive fractal shader experience. Explore generated geometries, manipulate light and color, and create stunning visual art in this WebGL app.

name: ChrisPirillo/orb-ashore
description: Orb Ashore is a real-time, interactive WebGL mathematical visualization engine. Explore abstract, evolving 3D procedural landscapes and light patterns directly in your browser.

name: ChrisPirillo/metal-petal
description: Metal Petal is an immersive, interactive WebGL generative art application. Create mesmerizing neon waves and metallic floral structures using real-time GLSL physics.

name: ChrisPirillo/frosty-pane
description: Frosty Pane is an interactive generative ice simulation. Create, melt, and randomize realistic frost patterns in your browser. Design 4K wallpapers with this WebGL frost architect.

name: ChrisPirillo/electric-ivy
description: Electric Ivy is a real-time, interactive WebGL fractal explorer. Manipulate 3D geometric folds, rotation axes, and saturation to generate infinite, organic digital art.

name: ChrisPirillo/cloudy-day
description: Experience Cloudy Day, a real-time WebGL cloud simulation engine. Customize wind speed, cloud density, lighting, and time of day in this interactive atmospheric physics experiment.

name: ChrisPirillo/claw-machine
description: Play the 3D Claw Machine arcade game online. Experience realistic physics, customize your grabber, and win digital prizes in this browser-based simulation.

name: ChrisPirillo/christmas-tree-maker
description: Design your perfect 3D Christmas tree in this interactive arcade game. Add lights, ornaments, snow, and gifts. Create and share your holiday masterpiece online.
